subject.title: Feature request: session:reset hook event for memory persistence on auto-resets

question: Which automatic reset hook contract should OpenClaw support for daily and idle rollover memory persistence?
rationale: The source-level gap is clear, but the permanent API shape affects internal hooks, typed plugin hooks, and upgrade-visible session behavior, so automation should not pick the contract alone.

options.title: Refine the active PR contract
options.body: Accept command-style daily/idle reset events plus lazy `before_reset` dispatch as the narrow fix path, then require proof and docs alignment before merge.

options.title: Design a typed session reset event
options.body: Pause the active PR and define a new `session:reset` or `session:before-reset` surface before wiring bundled session-memory to it.

options.title: Use session_end as the persistence hook
options.body: Keep automatic rollover on typed `session_end` and adapt memory persistence around that lifecycle surface instead of adding reset-specific command actions.

recommendation.title: Refine the active PR contract
recommendation.body: Accept command-style daily/idle reset events plus lazy `before_reset` dispatch as the narrow fix path, then require proof and docs alignment before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc is connected to recent session-memory/reset work and related branch repairs, making them the best available routing owner for the hook contract choice.
